name: saiyan
description: One bar above the prompt with two views: your plan's usage limits and pace, and the subagents' progress with a spiky-haired mascot per model. Ctrl+A or Option+A opens and closes it; the ⇄ before the fold toggle switches the view, and a click on the mascot picks the model and effort (Option+M, Option+E change them at once).

language.title: Language
language.description: The language before any flag is picked; the flag in the bar (US, FR, ES) sets it and is remembered across sessions. auto follows Claude Code's language setting (French or Spanish when it is, else English); en, fr, es, ru or he (Hebrew, drawn right to left) picks one. The usage view and the model choice speak English for ru and he

alerts.title: Usage alerts
alerts.description: on shows a toast once per window at 75% and 90% used, and when the pace will reach the limit before the reset; off shows none

formHaiku.title: Mascot form for Haiku
formHaiku.description: Which head the mascot wears on Haiku: base (Normal: black hair, no aura), charged (golden hair and aura), super (blue hair, bolts) or ultimate (red hair, flames, streaks)
